lines.text: The root is Fer! Offer, suffer.
Did you know? Fer is Latin for carry.
Quick quiz! Which means from under plus carry?

words.ex: The company offered her a job in London.
Many people suffer from back pain.

publish.title: Fer root: offer and suffer
publish.value: Fer comes from Latin "ferre" (to carry, to bring). Words: offer and suffer. offer = of + fer; suffer = suf + fer.
